dense_metric: cosine similarity; candidates with similarity >= 0, top 5; exact pgvector SQL verification

bm25.tokenizer: Unicode lowercase Latin/digit words plus Hangul character bigrams per Hangul run; no stemming or tuned dictionary
bm25.zero_score_policy: Return fixed top 5 including zero scores, like an unthresholded ranker; abstention not calibrated

rrf.candidate_scope: all 20 resolution documents; fuse full dense and BM25 ranks before taking top 5

primary: Recall@5 on answerable queries (equals Hit@5 with exactly one relevant document)
aggregation: Macro average queries; separately report three variants. Families have equal 3-query weight; 60 queries are not 60 independent incidents.
negative_queries: Separate diagnostic: no relevant document in corpus; report nonempty-return rate, no threshold tuning and no blending into positive-query scores.
split: Single frozen diagnostic evaluation set, no training or parameter search; not an independent held-out test after tuning.
timing: Local embedding batch elapsed time and retrieval timings are descriptive; not production latency benchmarks.
production_scope: Serialization, model and top-5 retrieval policy reproduced; production data untouched; no full Spring AI/agent end-to-end claim.
source_policy: Source snapshots remain local; public manifest holds URLs, fetched hashes and author-written grounding claims.
